preconditions.description: The grid size n is an integer between 1 and 2000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line) == n for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each of the n lines after the first has exactly n characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in {'S', 'G', '.'} for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for c in line)
preconditions.description: Each character in the grid is either 'S' (sinoper), 'G' (glaucous), or '.' (empty).

postconditions.description: The first line of output is either 'UNIQUE', 'NONE', or 'MULTIPLE' (all uppercase).
If the first line is 'UNIQUE', exactly n additional lines follow, each with n characters ('S' or 'G'). Otherwise, no additional lines are present.

postconditions.expression: all(c in {'S', 'G'} for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:] if stdout.strip() == 'UNIQUE' for c in line)
postconditions.description: If the first line is 'UNIQUE', all subsequent lines consist only of 'S' or 'G'.
The output is 'UNIQUE' if and only if there is exactly one valid mastapeece completion of the grid.
The output is 'NONE' if and only if no valid mastapeece completion exists.
The output is 'MULTIPLE' if and only if there is more than one valid mastapeece completion.
